verdict.rationale: Warp documents its own capability in this area: the Warp Agent handles payroll and asks the user when a decision is theirs. Warp also exposes HR and payroll data through its REST API and to external agents over MCP. However, no evidence shows a payroll-preview endpoint, anomaly detection, or an approval gate on a payroll run reachable via the API. Missing for 10: a documented payroll-run preview API, agent-driven anomaly surfacing, an explicit approve-run step via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
